Name: MJM QuickPlayer 1.00 Beta 60a / QuickPlayer 2010 .s3m Stack Buffer Overflow
Description: This module exploits a stack buffer overflow in MJM QuickPlayer 1.00 beta 60a and QuickPlayer 2010 (Multi-target exploit). When opening a malicious s3m file in one of these 2 applications, a stack buffer overflow can be triggered, resulting in arbitrary code execution. This exploit bypasses DEP & ASLR, and works on XP, Vista & Windows 7.
Targets: Windows Universal Generic DEP & ASLR Bypass
